description: Licensing status of non-code resources shipped in, or vendored into, this repository. Blocking statuses (unresolved, decision-needed, permission-scope-pending) are reported by scripts/check-release-content.py; graphical exports are additionally governed by approved-assets.json. Nothing listed here has been removed.

statuses.project-mit: Project work under the repository MIT license
statuses.third-party-open: Third-party data/code with terms compatible with redistribution (see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

statuses.permission-scope-pending: Permission exists but its exact scope, grantor authority or coverage of this file is not yet verified
